meta.title: A closed event cannot be bid on
gaps: The prepared closed RFQ has one bid rather than the specified two bids from Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90, so those exact bid values and participants cannot be asserted.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared closed RFQ has one bid rather than the specified two bids from Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90, so those exact bid values and participants cannot be asserted.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Continue in a separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the closed RFQ's pricing sheet as Vendor A.
Try changing the bid price and require the vendor portal to refuse the edit because the event is closed.
Assert that the vendor's price field is read-only.
Assert that submitting a quote is not available for the closed event.
Assert that the vendor portal displays the closed status.
